from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyUndistributedProfit(BaseModel):
    """One company's undistributed profit value from their financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock market security code, if provided")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date for this value")
    undistributed_profit: float | None = Field(description="Undistributed profit value (未分配利润) as reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit as written (e.g., '元')")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of balance: '期末余额' or similar, as written in document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_undistributed_profits: list[CompanyUndistributedProfit]
